assertions.name: gg_flavor_blind_bond_collapses_charge_asymmetry
assertions.source: The flavor-blind gg inter-nucleon bond (sigma_avg for every bond type) collapses the production charge asymmetry L_nn/L_pp-1 from ~78% to within 5% of zero (O(delta) flavor scale), confirming the 78% is a flavor-only-projection artifact. The residual + Coulomb is what a correct color-tube gg build must carry.

description: Tests whether building the inter-nucleon bond through flavor-blind gg production collapses the production charge-symmetry tension (bean 754x). Gluons couple color not flavor, so the leading gg interface is the same color-average sigma_avg = sigma - (h/2)I for every bond type. Recomputing L_pp/L_pn/L_nn with all inter-nucleon crossings forced to sigma_avg collapses the production L_nn/L_pp-1 ~ 78% (flavor-only sigma/sigma^-1) toward 0 (O(delta) flavor scale), and collapses the spurious mirror-nucleus split delta_B_sym(3H-3He) from +2.27 toward the unwired Coulomb scale (delta_B_AME=+0.76). Confirms the 78% is a flavor-only-projection artifact, not a derived isospin effect. The canonical gg bond is the color-tube-weighted 9-channel sum gated on conj:s5-so3-fiber-action. (a) scope-limited, no fit, no production rewire.
